_comment: Source of truth for the generated policy pages. Every claim here is drawn
from the app's own marketing page in this repo - nothing is invented - but
marketing copy is not a legal audit. Before publishing, check each app's
'_verify' list against what the shipped build actually does. A privacy
policy that overstates what an app does is worse than none at all.
GlowCompare for Windows is NOT generated here: it has a longer hand-written
policy at glowcompare-windows/privacy.html which this script leaves alone.

glowcompare.name: GlowCompare Skincare Tracker
glowcompare.subtitle: GlowCompare Skincare Tracker for Android
glowcompare.uninstall: Uninstalling GlowCompare through Android removes the app's private storage directory and every photo, routine and note held in it.
glowcompare.intro: GlowCompare helps you track skincare progress by taking photos over time, comparing them side by side, managing routines and products, and optionally requesting AI-powered skin analysis.
data: On device, in the app's private storage
Reminders, PAO expiry alerts, conflict warnings
Producing the 7-metric skin report you asked for
Sent to Google Gemini for processing; see section 5
Held by Google Play, not by us
permissions: Camera
Taking progress photos inside the app. Frames are never streamed anywhere; a photo exists only once you save it.
Photos / media
Importing an existing photo you choose, and saving comparisons you export. We can only see the files you pick.
Notifications
Routine reminders and product expiry alerts, scheduled locally on your device.
third_parties: When - and only when - you request an AI skin analysis or use the AI chat, the relevant photo and your question are sent to Google's Gemini API to generate the response. This is the one feature that leaves your device, it is never automatic, and the rest of the app works without it.
Processes credit purchases. We receive confirmation that a purchase succeeded; we never see your payment details.
glowcompare.iap_note: GlowCompare sells one-off AI credits through Google Play Billing. There is no subscription and no auto-renewal. Refunds are handled under Google Play's refund policy.
_verify: Does the shipped Android build send anything to Gemini other than the photo and prompt for an explicit user-initiated analysis?
Does the app request any permission not listed above (e.g. storage on older API levels)?
Confirm no crash/analytics SDK (Firebase, Crashlytics) is bundled - the policy states there is none.

notelock.name: Notelock
notelock.subtitle: Notelock encrypted notepad for Windows
notelock.uninstall: Uninstalling Notelock through Windows removes the app and its settings container. Documents you saved yourself stay where you put them, still encrypted.
notelock.intro: Notelock is a plain-text notepad that encrypts documents with AES-256 before they touch the disk. It opens as fast as Windows Notepad and asks for nothing in return.
data: Encrypted with AES-256 and stored only where you save them
Never stored, never transmitted, held in memory only while the document is open
On device, in the app's local settings container
permissions: File system access
Opening and saving the documents you choose. Notelock reads nothing you have not opened.
_verify: Confirm passwords are held in memory only and are zeroed on close.
Confirm the app makes no network calls at all (including update checks outside the Store).

slouch-guard.name: Slouch Guard
slouch-guard.subtitle: Slouch Guard real-time AI posture corrector for Windows
slouch-guard.uninstall: Uninstalling Slouch Guard through Windows removes the app, its settings and its posture history.
slouch-guard.intro: Slouch Guard watches your posture through your webcam and nudges you with a screen-edge glow when you slouch. The computer-vision engine runs natively on your PC.
slouch-guard.camera_note: This is the part of Slouch Guard people ask about most, so to be explicit: webcam frames are analysed in memory on your own machine and are discarded immediately. No frame is written to disk, uploaded, or sent to any server. The app needs the camera on to work at all, and turning the camera off is the reliable way to stop it watching.
data: Detecting your posture in real time
Processed in memory on your PC and discarded - never written to disk or uploaded
Your own session history and trends
On device, in the app's local settings container
permissions: Camera
Real-time posture detection. Without it the app has nothing to analyse. Revoke it at any time in Windows Settings and Slouch Guard simply stops detecting.
_verify: Confirm no frame or derived image is ever persisted to disk, including in crash dumps or debug logs.
Confirm posture statistics contain no image data.

aes-vault.name: AES Vault
aes-vault.subtitle: AES Vault file and folder encryption for Windows
aes-vault.uninstall: Uninstalling AES Vault removes the app and its shell integration. Files you encrypted stay encrypted and stay where you left them - keep your passwords.
aes-vault.intro: AES Vault encrypts files and folders with AES-256-GCM straight from the File Explorer right-click menu. Keys are derived from your password with 600,000 rounds of PBKDF2.
data: The files you choose to encrypt or decrypt
Processed locally; output written where you choose
Never stored and never transmitted; wiped from RAM after use
On device, in the app's local settings container
permissions: File system access
Reading the file or folder you right-clicked and writing the result. Nothing else is touched.
Shell integration
Adding the Encrypt / Decrypt entries to the File Explorer context menu.
aes-vault.security_note: AES Vault cannot recover your data if you forget a password. There is no backdoor, no recovery key held by us, and no way for us to help - that is the point of the design, and it is also a real risk you carry. Keep your passwords somewhere safe.
_verify: Confirm the RAM-wiping claim matches the shipped build.
Confirm no filenames or paths are written to any log that leaves the machine.

mortgage-loan-emi-pro.name: Mortgage Loan EMI Pro Insights
mortgage-loan-emi-pro.subtitle: Mortgage Loan EMI Pro Insights for Windows
mortgage-loan-emi-pro.settings_path: Windows Settings → Apps → Mortgage Loan EMI Pro Insights
mortgage-loan-emi-pro.uninstall: Uninstalling the app through Windows removes it and any scenarios saved inside it. Spreadsheets you exported yourself are unaffected.
mortgage-loan-emi-pro.intro: Mortgage Loan EMI Pro Insights is an offline calculator for loan repayment: EMI schedules, prepayment scenarios, inflation adjustment and full amortisation tables you can export to Excel.
data: On device only - they are inputs to a calculator, not an account
Letting you reopen a comparison later
Written to the location you pick; where they go next is up to you
permissions: File system access
Writing the .xlsx exports you ask for.
mortgage-loan-emi-pro.financial_note: The app performs arithmetic on the numbers you enter. It is not financial advice, it does not connect to any bank or lender, and its projections are estimates - check them against your lender's own figures before acting on them.
_verify: Confirm there is no update check or telemetry call in the shipped build.

Sent to Google Gemini for transcription; see section 5
